  void addCurrentNote() {
    if (inNote && currentNote.isNotEmpty) {
      final int? value = noteValues[currentNote];
      if (value != null) {
        currentMeasure.add(value);
      }
      inNote = false;
    }
  }
  
  void endOfMeasure() {
    if (currentMeasure.isNotEmpty) {
      result.addAll(currentMeasure);
      currentMeasure.clear();
    }
  }
  
  for (final char in musicString.codeUnits) {
    switch (char) {
      case 92: // Backslash
        addCurrentNote();
        break;
        
      case 10: // Newline
        addCurrentNote();
        endOfMeasure();
        break;
        
      default:
        if ('A' <= char.toString().toUpperCase()[0] && 'Z' >= char.toString().toUpperCase()[0]) {
          inNote = true;
          currentNote += char.toString();
        } else {
          addCurrentNote();
        }
    }
  }
  
  addCurrentNote(); // Add the last note after loop ends
  
  return result;
}

List<int> parseMusic(String musicString) {
  final noteValues = [1, 2, 3];
  int totalNotes = 0;
  int currentNoteIndex = -1;

  for (int i = 0; i < musicString.length; i++) {
    if (musicString[i] == '.') {
      continue;
    } else if (musicString[i].isDigit()) {
      int digitValue = int.parse(musicString[i]);
      if (digitValue <= 9 && digitValue > 0) {
        // This is a single-digit number
        currentNoteIndex++;
        if (currentNoteIndex >= noteValues.length) {
          throw Exception('Too many notes');
        }
        totalNotes += noteValues[currentNoteIndex];
      } else {
        // Handle multi-digit numbers by considering next characters as part of the same number
        String fullNumber = '';
        while (i < musicString.length && musicString[i].isDigit()) {
          fullNumber += musicString[i++];
        }
        int value = int.tryParse(fullNumber)!;
        currentNoteIndex++;
        if (value <= 9 && value > 0) {
          if (currentNoteIndex >= noteValues.length) {
            throw Exception('Too many notes');
          }
          totalNotes += noteValues[currentNoteIndex];
        } else {
          throw Exception('Invalid note value $fullNumber');
        }
      }
    } else if (musicString[i] == ',' || musicString[i] == '-' || musicString[i] == '+' || 
              musicString[i] == '=' || musicString[i] == '<' || musicString[i] == '>' ||
              musicString[i] == '(' || musicString[i] == ')' || musicString[i] == '{' || 
              musicString[i] == '}') {
      // These are operators or separators and should be ignored
      continue;
    } else {
      throw Exception("Unknown character ${musicString[i]}");
    }
  }

  return List.generate(totalNotes, (_) => Random().nextInt(65535));
}

List<double> rescaleToUnit(List<double> numbers) {
  if (numbers.isEmpty) return [];
  
  double min = numbers.reduce(min);
  double max = numbers.reduce(max);
  double range = max - min;
  
  if (range == 0.0) return List.filled(numbers.length, 0.0);
  
  return numbers.map((num) => (num - min) / range).toList();
}

List<int> sortArray(List<int> array) {
  // Make a copy of the original array to avoid mutating it
  List<int> arr = [...array];
  
  int n = arr.length;
  for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
    int minIndex = i;
    
    // Find the minimum element in the unsorted part of the array
    for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
      if (arr[j] < arr[minIndex]) {
        minIndex = j;
      }
    }
    
    // Swap the found minimum element with the first element of the unsorted part
    if (minIndex != i) {
      int temp = arr[i];
      arr[i] = arr[minIndex];
      arr[minIndex] = temp;
    }
  }
  
  return arr;
}
